summary: Captured and implemented the actual deferred Claude Code cookie attachment uploader; qualified byte-preserving upload/download and Code-worker consumption, not just Chat upload or enqueue acknowledgements.

reuse.upstream: Read-only upstream/main has no claude_rc/files.py; existing fork FilesMixin and client._send remain the sole file/HTTP owners.
reuse.source: Reused prior bundle research; traced current Code composer through shared Os/ip/ltK symbols and captured the actual browser request including store_as_is=true.

implementation: Cookie upload_attachment selects POST /api/{org}/upload?store_as_is=true with multipart file. Bearer CLI OAuth route and Files API routes remain unchanged.
Cookie download_attachment selects GET /api/organizations/{org}/files/{uuid}/contents; identifiers are URL-quoted.
Cookie refs retain the captured mime_type field; send_message_with_files retains it alongside existing optional digest/size fields.
Cookie lane options fail before HTTP rather than inventing upload headers.
Malformed upload replies fail without including the raw server body in the ValueError.
Executable scripts/claude-rc-upload-smoke uses existing cookie auth, lifecycle and processing-receipt-aware send_and_collect; verifies correlated Bash tool results and exact session deletion.

tests.live_client_harness: passed: exact binary byte download, original SHA-256 in correlated successful Bash result, successful terminal worker result, archived/deleted session GET 404
tests.browser_capture: Code composer Send performed actual deferred ZIP upload; worker sha256sum matched independent download and unzip -p returned generated proof text

remaining: No standalone org attachment deletion contract captured. Both exact test sessions were deleted and return GET 404, but both uploaded blobs remain readable. No fabricated DELETE, retention expiry or upload-cleanup claim.
Nonempty attachment prefetch has no separately asserted prefetch effect; ordinary attachment consumption does not qualify it.
Files API mount/seed uses a distinct file ID contract and is not qualified by org attachment uploads.
No public panel or media CLI upload acceptance was changed or claimed.

safety.browser_notice: Dismissed transient notification offer only in the owned tab; did not grant browser notification permissions.
